Class TankBuilder

java.lang.Object
src.components.TankBuilder
public class TankBuilder extends Object
Builder class for constructing Tank instances. This class follows the Builder design pattern, allowing for flexible and readable tank creation.

Example: 

Tank tank = new TankBuilder(50)
    .unit("liters")
    .storing("fuel")
    .build();

Tank barrel = new TankBuilder(55)
    .type("Barrel")
    .unit("gallons")
    .storing("water")
    .build();

      public TankBuilder(int capacity)
